$comment: Prestige-owned open-slot source, mirroring the windows Prestige publishes in the Google Appointment Schedule (240-minute appointments). The site never books through Google — finishing that form holds the slot before payment — so these windows are what /book and /api/open-slots serve. Edit this file, or set the PRESTIGE_AVAILABILITY env var to a JSON object with the same shape, when Emory opens or closes hours. Times are local wall-clock in `timeZone`, 24-hour HH:MM, and each entry is the START of one appointment window.
$confirmedWindows: 2026-09-24 (Derek): Sat 9:00-13:00, Sun 9:00-13:00, Sun 16:00-20:00 ET. Add weekday starts to `weekly` when Emory opens them.
